title: Faster Auto-Coloring & Expanded Local Question Templates
body:
- Bulk-preloaded SQLite list relations for Countrydle auto-coloring, cutting simple map highlight computation from ~100 ms to ~3 ms.
- Skipped auto-coloring for overly complex quantified or deeply nested queries across Countrydle and regional modes so answers return promptly.
- Expanded deterministic English templates for landlocked, continent, demonym, hemisphere, directional, and flag color questions so common queries answer in milliseconds without an LLM round-trip.
